seoDescription: Learn what the Open Hands emoji 👐 really means.

longForm.overview:
The 👐 Open Hands emoji was added in Unicode 6 (2010) and is drawn as two yellow open hands, palms facing up, in a gesture of openness or showing emptiness. The visual cue reads instantly as openness, 'I have nothing,' or the visible 'look, hands up' tag. By 2026 👐 has become the go-to emoji for the openness reaction, the visible-'nothing to hide' tag, and the welcoming-coded open-arms default.

In modern chat 👐 does very specific work. People send it as a literal openness feeling, as the visible 'I have nothing' tag, or as the welcoming open-arms default. The two-open-palms-up are the visual cue that the gesture is openness-coded. Writers should pick 👐 when the read is openness or welcoming, and avoid it when the read is hugging — 🤗 fits better for hug-coded moments.
longForm.howPeopleUseIt:
👐 lands on a friend's 'nothing to hide' message, in a work channel where someone is showing openness, and in a dating-app DM where the sender is welcoming. The two-open-palms anchor the read.

In close-friends chats 👐 reads as the universal 'open arms' tag. On X the emoji punctuates openness-coded tweets. The emoji pairs with 🤗 for the layered openness-and-hug stack and with 🫶 for the visible love-pair stack.
longForm.whenNotToUse: Skip 👐 in any context where the read is hugging — 🤗 fits better. Avoid 👐 in ironic contexts where the openness is faked — 🙄 fits better there.
longForm.howToReply:
If a friend sends 👐 on an openness message, mirror with another 👐 or 🤗 to match the welcoming energy. The open-arms chain reads as solidarity.

If 👐 lands as the welcoming default, reply with another 👐 or 🫶. And if you want to send 👐 yourself, pair it with the moment so the openness read is clear.

faqs.question: What does 👐 mean in text?
faqs.answer: 👐 means openness, 'nothing to hide,' or welcoming-coded open-arms. The two-open-palms-up are the visual cue that the gesture is openness-coded.

faqs.question: Is 👐 flirty?
faqs.answer: Sometimes, gently. 👐 can read as soft-coded flirty welcoming in a dating thread. It is warmth-coded rather than pure romance-coded.

faqs.question: What does 👐 mean from a guy?
faqs.answer: From a guy or anyone, 👐 carries the same openness read. There is no gendered meaning; the emoji works the same regardless.

faqs.question: What does 👐 mean at work?
faqs.answer: In Slack, 👐 reads as the 'nothing to hide' tag when admitting a small mistake. Pair with a sentence about the issue so the channel stays useful.
